kicker: A workshop holds a hundred chisels — a good carver knows which one each cut needs.
summary: Pick the right chisel for the right cut — and always know how much water is left in the jar.

quiz.q: You are making 20 review videos where a virtual model holds the product. Before posting, which step must you not skip?

Label it as AI and check image and music rights
Post fast to catch the trend
quiz.explain: Vietnam's AI Law requires a clearly recognisable label when AI imitates a real person; using a real person's image needs their consent.

market.label: Night market under the moon
market.art: Ink painting seen from a small boat in the middle of a night lake: a lamp on the bow, and out on the water three market stalls on stilts at three distances. The nearest, the all-in-one stall, hangs a cluster of seven paper lanterns in many ink tones, its reflection a seven-coloured band; the two specialist stalls each hang one large lantern, reflected as a single amber streak. Each stall's name and trade is written on its cloth curtain. Four floating lanterns drift beside the boat, each carrying a task.
market.prompt: Drag each lantern to the stall that does that job well

stalls.name: Many-model stall

facts.text: Higgsfield says it offers 30+ models, including Sora, Kling, Veo, Seedance and Wan, plus Cinema Studio for camera moves.
Higgsfield says Marketing Studio goes from one product link to an ad video with a presenter, voice and lip-sync.
TopView lists URL to Video, Product Avatar (a virtual presenter for products) and Video Agent among its tools.
On 28 April 2026 Freepik renamed itself Magnific, bundling upscaling, image/video generation, shared workspaces and an asset library.

insight.text: There is no best stall: a specialist does one job very well, the many-model stall does many jobs. Choose by the job you need.

market.detail: The features here are the companies' own claims (◇). Try a free plan with your real job before you pay.

path.label: The path of one asset
path.art: Ink painting from high behind the workshop gate: raked sand winding round two mossy rocks, eight shallow hollows making an S-shaped path that recedes toward the lake, where a stone lantern waits to be lit. Eight stepping stones lie on the near sand; set in the right order, the path lights up, and at the end the lantern is lit and its reflection appears on the lake.
path.pathAria: An eight-step stone path for making an AI asset
path.keys: Tap in turn, or use number keys 1 to 8.
path.done: The path is lit. Open your take-away card.

steps.label: Write a brief
steps.detail: One page: goal, audience, one message, format, deadline, credit budget.
steps.why: A clear brief means the model guesses less and you redo less.

steps.label: Choose a model
steps.detail: Choose by task: still image, presenter video, or a scene that needs camera moves.
steps.why: Each model has its own strengths and costs a different number of credits.

steps.label: Draft several options
steps.detail: 3–4 options at low resolution, with the same prompt or small tweaks.
steps.why: Cheap drafts let you compare before spending a lot.

steps.label: Pick one
steps.detail: Put them side by side and judge against the brief, not a passing mood.
steps.why: Going back to the brief keeps you on target.

steps.label: Upscale & fix
steps.detail: Upscale the chosen one; fix weak spots like hands, text, logos.
steps.why: Upscale only the final one so you don't burn credits on rejects.

steps.label: Edit
steps.detail: Assemble shots, text and music in an editor such as CapCut or Premiere.
steps.why: AI gives you material; you still tell the story.

steps.label: Check rights & add AI label
steps.detail: Rights to real people's images, music licences, AI labels per law and platform rules.
steps.why: Taking it down after posting means the harm is already done.

steps.label: Post & save the recipe
steps.detail: Post it; save the prompt, model and seed of the final version.
steps.why: With a recipe, next time is faster and consistent.

insight.text: A good AI asset passes many stations: cheap drafts, careful picking, then upscaling — and a rights check before posting.

path.detail: This order is AI Zen's suggestion, not a standard. The editors named are only examples; use whatever tool you know.

credit.label: Credits are water in a jar
credit.art: A still life in the night workshop: a crackle-glazed moon jar on a plank bench, a quarter of its body cut away like a museum piece to show the water column and the carved marks inside. A moonbeam from the paper window pours into the jar's mouth. In front: a bamboo rack with a small dipper and a big ladle, a narrow and a wide neck collar, two hourglasses, a tea bowl; wooden tags hang under the bench for choosing. Each time you generate, the ladle takes water out and pours it into the bowl; the level drops.
credit.prompt: Drag the small ladle into the jar
credit.cost: This one cost {n} parts (the whole jar is 100).
credit.shortTry: Not enough water — refill the jar
credit.short: Not enough water for this one: {left} parts left, it needs {n}.
credit.empty: The jar is dry. Wait for the next cycle's refill, or buy more.

The same page says subscription credits renew each cycle and do not roll over to the next one.

tips: Draft at low resolution; upscale only the final pick.
Check the price on the generate button before confirming.

insight.text: The same video: the heavy, sharp, long version costs 33 parts; the light one costs 5. Draft light, and make the heavy version only once you've decided.

credit.detail: Credits are points you pay for in advance to use a platform; each generation takes a few. The numbers here only illustrate proportions. Check the official pricing page, and whether credits roll over to the next cycle.

real.label: Real and fake
real.art: Ink painting from the bank of a night lake, looking across: an arched bridge spans the water, and bridge and reflection close into one circle. On top of the bridge stands a model in a vermilion scarf, the moon behind her in the mist. Her reflection in the water is a polygon avatar drawn in thin straight lines. Four stones on the bank, each with a small lamp waiting to be lit.
real.waterAria: The pond: swipe a finger or press Space to ripple it

view.text: Vietnam's AI Law, from 1 March 2026: AI images, video or voices imitating real people must carry a clearly recognisable label.
I don't need to know which tool you used — but I need to know whether the person in the video is real.
Civil Code: using someone's image requires their consent; commercial use requires paying them.
YouTube asks creators to disclose realistic AI content, such as making a real person say something they didn't.

common.text: All agree viewers have a right to know. They differ on where the label goes, how big it is, and who is responsible.

real.detail: The law also requires a clear notice when AI content could mislead about real events or people; artworks are labelled in a way that doesn't spoil enjoyment. This is not legal advice.
